General-purpose AI systems are sold predominantly on the basis of economic benefits, with little attention given to social or non-financial benefits. Policymakers tasked with regulating AI while balancing European Union (EU) rights and values with innovation and free market competition face a seemingly impossible task. A change of priorities is urgently needed in EU tech policy. Current policy predominantly focuses on risk mitigation rather than delivering socially beneficial technologies.
